If you're using an iPhone 16 or newer, you may want to find a Qi2.2 charger so your phone can take full advantage of its supported 25W MagSafe charging speeds. Anker's newly released 25W Prime MagSafe three-in-one charger is a great choice, with an extremely portable design.

第一印象

The big trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and this trend continues into 2026. Anker is leading the way in this regard — their brand-new portable MagSafe three-in-one charger integrates 25W Qi2.2 support into an extremely lightweight design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost a must. Nearly every 25W charger on the market comes equipped with this feature, and Anker's new foldable three-in-one charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and USB-C cable, more than enough to charge your iPhone, AirPods and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this charging stand, you can charge an iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you once loved this product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you'll probably like this new offering. It's almost as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two main advantages: it works as a stand, and it can charge three devices at once instead of two.

This charger has a rather interesting (though admittedly not strictly necessary) feature — the Apple Watch charger uses a pop-up design. When you fold the charger closed, it tucks away; but when you're ready to open it, you just give it a press and it pops right out. I find this design quite clever, and it also helps justify the product's premium price tag.

總結

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe three-in-one charger, Anker's new product is an excellent choice. With its built-in active cooling, it can quickly charge your iPhone without overheating or causing the other side effects that wireless charging sometimes brings.

Anker's new three-in-one MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99, with free shipping for Prime members, in both black and white.
